The company works closely with major insurance providers, restoring facilities quickly within agreed policy limits during emergencies. Damand Services prioritizes same-day call-outs whenever possible, with engineers available seven days a week to ensure customers receive prompt, reliable support. With over 30 years of experience, Gas Safe and SafeContractor approvals, and fully vetted staff, the company is recognized for professional, courteous service at competitive prices. Landlord services include comprehensive gas safety checks to keep rental properties safe and compliant. Role Description The Central Heating Engineer role at Damand Services is a full-time remote position focused on delivering high-quality central heating and plumbing services to residential and commercial clients. Day-to-day responsibilities include diagnosing and repairing central heating systems, boilers, including Natiral gas, LPG and unvented works, as well as performing routine maintenance and safety checks. The engineer will respond to emergency breakdowns, coordinate with insurance providers, and ensure work is completed in line with industry regulations and company standards. Additional tasks involve advising customers on system improvements, documenting work carried out, and collaborating with office staff to schedule and prioritize jobs efficiently. Remote work will involve traveling to customer sites from a home base, maintaining clear communication via phone and digital tools. Qualifications Strong technical skills in central heating systems, boiler diagnostics, and repair, including experience with modern and traditional setups. Competence in all boiler systems and gas safety procedures, with current Gas Safe registration. Solid plumbing skills covering installation, maintenance, and repair of domestic and commercial plumbing fixtures and pipework. Experience in general building maintenance, including basic fault finding and ensuring systems and facilities remain safe and functional. Excellent customer service skills, with the ability to communicate clearly, manage expectations, and provide professional, courteous support. Relevant vocational qualifications (e.g., NVQ or equivalent in Plumbing and Heating), and a valid driver’s license for travel to customer sites. Strong problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, and capability to work independently in a remote, field-based environment. Availability for occasional evening or weekend call-outs and familiarity with working under insurance policy requirements is beneficial.

Dans le cadre de sa planification stratégique, SOS Villages d’Enfants Guinée lance un appel à candidature pour le recrutement d’un(e) Coordinateur (trice) National(e) pour le Développement du Partenariat Institutionnel (CN IPD). Voir plus Transport Conakry Actualités Guinée Africains et diasporas Le Poste Relevant directement du Directeur national, le/la Coordonnateur(trice) National(e) pour le Développement du Partenariat institutionnel aura à : Définir un plan d’action visant à développer les partenariats locaux (partenaires institutionnels et partenaires entreprises) de l’association nationale. Proposer des actions novatrices et créatives pour développer le financement local de l’organisation. Identifier les opportunités de partenariats institutionnels au niveau local (ambassades, organismes étatiques, agences de coopération et de développement, appels à projet…). Répondre à des appels à propositions de bailleurs de fonds nationaux et internationaux. Développer et maintenir de bonnes relations avec les bailleurs de fonds en assurant une communication et un suivi réguliers. Travailler avec les départements concernés pour le suivi technique et financier des projets approuvés. Le Profil Titulaire d’un Bac+4/5 en Développement, en Sciences Sociales ou dans d‘autres domaines pertinents. Au moins 5 ans d’expérience dans la collecte de fonds, de préfence dans une structure non-étatique. Personne dynamique, motivée et ayant une capacité à communiquer efficacement avec les bailleurs de fonds et les partenaires. Capacité à identifier des opportunités et les saisir. Personne orientée vers une approche de résultats avec des compétences en planification, en budgétisation et en analyse. Fortes capacités à développer un plan d’action et à travailler de manière indépendante pour l’atteinte des objectifs et des cibles fixées. Fortes capacités d’adaptation et qualités relationnelles pour travailler avec des personnes à différents niveaux de l’organisation Sens de l’organisation et de la rigueur pour répondre aux exigences des bailleurs de fonds Connaissances des politiques de coopération et de financement des bailleurs de fonds institutionnels et des donateurs, un atout majeur Maîtrise de l’approche de la Gestion Axée sur les Résultats (GAR) et de la Gestion du Cycle de Projet (GCP). Très bonnes compétences orales et écrites en français et en anglais. Maîtrise des outils informatiques (Word, Excel, Power Point) Conditions Du Poste Etre de nationalité guinéenne. Poste basé à Conakry. Date d’entrée en fonction : immédiate. Nous Offrons Un salaire et des avantages compétitifs ; Un environnement de travail en équipe ; Opportunité de travailler pour une ONG reconnue et respectée. Nb Les candidat(e)s doivent adresser au Directeur National de SOS Village d’Enfants Guinée : une lettre de motivation, un curriculum vitae, une copie des diplômes et des attestations des expériences dans les domaines couverts par le poste (stages, formations etc.), la liste de trois personnes de référence avec leur adresse complète, Les dossiers susmentionnés devront être envoyés aux adresses électroniques suivantes : Ressources.Humaines@sosguinea.org et sos-no@sosguinea.org avec en objet la mention : Candidature au poste SOS/IPD/2016 La date limite de réception des dossiers est fixée au 10/08/2016 Les dossiers de candidature incomplets et non-conformes au profil recherché ne seront pas examinés. Key Responsibilities / Duties & Responsibilities Service Operations & Daily SLA Execution End-to-End Case Resolution: Execute standard operating procedures discipline for incoming ticket resolutions to meet strict SLA targets (Response & Resolution Time). Intake & Technical Analysis: Collect comprehensive technical data (photos, videos, chronology) from customers to diagnose root causes accurately. Remote Solution Architecture: Formulate step-by-step troubleshooting guidelines and provide remote diagnostic guidance/product education as the priority first step to optimize resolution speed. Vendor Coordination & Scheduling: Liaise and coordinate directly with authorized external service vendors to efficiently schedule and assign on-site service visits for complex cases. On-Site Technical Support: Conduct field visits or site inspections if required Digital Discipline & Process Compliance Real-Time Data Integrity: Maintain 100% data accuracy by documenting all service stages, customer communications, and technical findings in real-time. Digital Tool Adoption: Actively utilize company digital service platforms, including Salesforce Desktop, Field Service Lightning App, and Partner Portals. Warranty Claim Management (SAP): Process, validate, and manage warranty claims directly within the digital platforms, ensuring accurate entitlement verification and data mapping for all resolved cases. Technical Quality & Customer Interaction First-Time Fix Optimization: Guarantee that all individual technical interventions yield a permanent, complete fix to eliminate recurring complaints and minimize zero re-work. Customer Feedback Collection: Actively prompt and capture customer satisfaction (CSAT) scores and feedback immediately following a post-resolution task. Preventive Client Education: Provide clear, professional preventive education to retail consumers, contractors, and building management regarding proper product maintenance and usage. Parts Alignment & Feedback Loop Spare Parts Deployment: Request, track, and mobilize the correct mandatory spare parts from the warehouse required for case completion. Technical Quality Reporting: Identify and flag recurring product failures or design defects, feeding accurate field details to the Technical Lead to assist with the R&D and Manufacturing feedback loop. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Technical SLA Achievement: % of tickets resolved successfully within the standard timeline (On-time Resolution). Technical CSAT: Customer Satisfaction Score specific to technical capability and solution quality. First-Time Fix Rate / Zero Re-work: % of complaints permanently resolved in a single intervention. Data Accuracy & Log Compliance: 100% real-time updating and complete reporting of customer cases via Salesforce. Education Job Qualifications and Requirements Higher Nitec, Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Industrial) or a related technical discipline. Experience Minimum of 2–4 years of customer service experience or hands-on experience in Technical Service, Field Engineering, or Equipment Troubleshooting within a fast-paced environment. Experience interacting with retail consumers, main contractors, and commercial building maintenance teams Skills Ontime (Service Completion): Strong analytical troubleshooting skills, proactive resource planning for parts, and high task ownership. Navigating (Customer Interactions): High emotional intelligence for problem-solving, structured technical report writing, and clear, empathetic stakeholder education. Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience or high proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce) and Microsoft Office / Google Workspace. Work Conditions Aftersales Office

review_candidates.title: Software Engineer - Cloud Computing
review_candidates.description: About The Company L3Harris Technologies is a global aerospace and defense technology company committed to delivering innovative solutions that address the complex challenges of national security and civil markets. Our organization is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers' mission and their own professional growth. L3Harris fosters an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life balance. Our culture is built on core values such as integrity, innovation, and excellence, with a strong focus on community engagement and technological advancement. We strive to be a trusted partner in defense technology, connecting space, air, land, sea, and cyber domains to support national security objectives. About The Role The Specialist, Software Engineering (AWS Cloud) role is a vital position within the GGSS Cloud team at L3Harris Technologies. The successful candidate will be responsible for operating, maintaining, and enhancing our cloud-based systems primarily utilizing Amazon Web Services (AWS). This role involves working with modern cloud architectures, including Kubernetes-based environments, to support our mission-critical applications. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software development, cloud infrastructure, and security best practices. They will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless deployment, monitoring, and optimization of cloud services, contributing to the company's goal of delivering innovative, reliable, and secure technology solutions for defense and government clients. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a Bachelor's Degree with a minimum of four years of relevant experience, or a graduate degree with at least two years of experience. Alternatively, candidates with eight or more years of experience without a degree are also considered. Proven expertise in developing and deploying containerized applications using Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, or similar tools is essential. Experience working within Linux environments, including scripting, configuration, and software deployment, is required. Familiarity with configuration management tools such as Ansible, Chef, or Puppet, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, CloudFormation, or similar is also necessary. Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA), or AWS Certified DevOps Engineer - Associate are highly preferred. A successful candidate must also be able to obtain a High-Risk NOAA Public Trust clearance, which requires U.S. citizenship. Responsibilities Monitor and implement updates from AWS and third-party vendors to ensure system security and performance. Maintain and enhance Kubernetes-based cloud architecture to support scalable and resilient applications. Develop, support, and troubleshoot cloud applications using programming languages such as Python, Java, or C++. Support Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, including single sign-on, Active Directory, or Keycloak, to ensure secure access controls. Assist in migrating existing applications to the cloud environment, ensuring minimal downtime and data integrity. Create and maintain comprehensive documentation for developers, administrators, and operators to facilitate ongoing system management. Ensure consistency across system configurations by applying version tagging, naming schemes, and configuration standards. Leverage networking principles and security best practices within the AWS cloud environment to ensure system integrity and compliance. Design, develop, and modify software to add new features or improve existing functionalities. Collaborate with team members to implement best practices in cloud security, deployment, and monitoring. Benefits L3Harris Technologies offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health, well-being, and professional development of our employees. Benefits include competitive health insurance plans, retirement savings options, paid time off, and flexible work schedules. We also provide opportunities for continuous learning and certification, along with wellness programs and employee assistance services. Our commitment to work-life balance and a positive work environment ensures that employees are supported both professionally and personally, fostering a culture of innovation and excellence. Equal Opportunity L3Harris Technologies is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and dignity. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, age, national origin, ethnicity, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, disability, genetic information, citizenship status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. We maintain a drug-free workplace and conduct pre-employment substance abuse testing and background checks where permitted by law. Many of our positions require the ability to obtain security clearances, which are only granted to U.S. citizens. By applying for this role, you acknowledge that your information may be shared with subsidiaries and affiliated companies for employment consideration.
